title: Mixed-tier interop: emulated MSP430 Sky (RPL root) + native Cooja mote
note: Demonstrates cross-tier 802.15.4 radio + RPL interop: the native mote joins the sky root's DAG (DIO/DAO/parent, bidirectional link-layer ACKs). udp-sender uses the simple-udp broadcast app, so this exercises the network stack rather than rpl-udp request/response payloads.
